trials.name: per-channel axis-mix frontend
trials.hypothesis: Add a learned front end with one X-by-X and one Y-by-Y mixing matrix per input channel. The stem sees the raw observation plus the x-mixed, y-mixed and xy-mixed copies, so it can learn the hidden cyclic x-shift and line target cells up with the true action positions. The rest of the network and the recipe stay at the default, to isolate this perception fix. If dev success stays at about 0 and the agent still picks DONE first, that refutes it, unless the higher-exploration version (candidate 3) succeeds.

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class AxisMix(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, ny, nx):
        super().__init__()
        self.wx = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, nx, nx))
        self.wy = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, ny, ny))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wx, -1.0 / math.sqrt(nx), 1.0 / math.sqrt(nx))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wy, -1.0 / math.sqrt(ny), 1.0 / math.sqrt(ny))

    def forward(self, o):
        xm = torch.einsum('bcyx,cwx->bcyw', o, self.wx)
        ym = torch.einsum('bcyx,cvy->bcvx', o, self.wy)
        xym = torch.einsum('bcyx,cvy->bcvx', xm, self.wy)
        return torch.cat([o, xm, ym, xym], dim=1)


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.amix = AxisMix(spec.in_channels, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(4 * spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(self.amix(obs))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

trials.name: cell transformer with one-hot coords
trials.hypothesis: Treat each cell as a token. Embed the observation plus constant one-hot x and y coordinate channels, then apply two self-attention layers (d=48). Attention between positions can learn any fixed spatial remapping, such as the hidden x-shift, and long-range relations between columns. The footprint pooling head scores placements at each token's own true position. Lower lr and 2 PPO epochs give attention more samples. import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"lr": 0.0005, "ppo_epochs": 2}

D = 48
HEADS = 4
FF = 96
LAYERS = 2
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class Block(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, d, heads, ff):
        super().__init__()
        self.nh = heads
        self.ln1 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.qkv = nn.Linear(d, 3 * d)
        self.proj = nn.Linear(d, d)
        self.ln2 = nn.LayerNorm(d)
        self.ff1 = nn.Linear(d, ff)
        self.ff2 = nn.Linear(ff, d)

    def forward(self, t):
        b, n, d = t.shape
        hd = d // self.nh
        qkv = self.qkv(self.ln1(t)).view(b, n, 3, self.nh, hd).permute(2, 0, 3, 1, 4)
        q, k, v = qkv[0], qkv[1], qkv[2]
        att = torch.softmax(torch.matmul(q, k.transpose(-1, -2)) / math.sqrt(hd), dim=-1)
        o = torch.matmul(att, v).transpose(1, 2).reshape(b, n, d)
        t = t + self.proj(o)
        t = t + self.ff2(F.gelu(self.ff1(self.ln2(t))))
        return t


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.X = spec.X
        self.Y = spec.Y
        self.embed = nn.Linear(spec.in_channels + spec.X + spec.Y, D)
        self.blocks = nn.ModuleList([Block(D, HEADS, FF) for _ in range(LAYERS)])
        self.lnf = nn.LayerNorm(D)
        self.head = PoolHead(D, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * D, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        B = obs.shape[0]
        Y = self.Y
        X = self.X
        ex = torch.eye(X, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, X, 1, X).expand(B, X, Y, X)
        ey = torch.eye(Y, device=obs.device, dtype=obs.dtype).view(1, Y, Y, 1).expand(B, Y, Y, X)
        h = torch.cat([obs, ex, ey], dim=1)
        t = h.flatten(2).transpose(1, 2)
        t = self.embed(t)
        for blk in self.blocks:
            t = blk(t)
        t = self.lnf(t)
        f = t.transpose(1, 2).reshape(B, D, Y, X)
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import math
import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"ent_coef": 0.03, "ppo_epochs": 2}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32


class AxisMix(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, ny, nx):
        super().__init__()
        self.wx = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, nx, nx))
        self.wy = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, ny, ny))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wx, -1.0 / math.sqrt(nx), 1.0 / math.sqrt(nx))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wy, -1.0 / math.sqrt(ny), 1.0 / math.sqrt(ny))

    def forward(self, o):
        xm = torch.einsum('bcyx,cwx->bcyw', o, self.wx)
        ym = torch.einsum('bcyx,cvy->bcvx', o, self.wy)
        xym = torch.einsum('bcyx,cvy->bcvx', xm, self.wy)
        return torch.cat([o, xm, ym, xym], dim=1)


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.amix = AxisMix(spec.in_channels, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(4 * spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(self.amix(obs))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
AX = 24


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.X = spec.X
        self.Y = spec.Y
        c = spec.in_channels
        self.s1 = nn.Conv2d(c, STEM, 1)
        self.xconv = nn.Conv2d(c, AX, (1, spec.X))
        self.yconv = nn.Conv2d(c, AX, (spec.Y, 1))
        self.s2 = nn.Conv2d(STEM + 2 * AX, COL, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        a = F.relu(self.s1(obs))
        px = F.pad(obs, (0, self.X - 1, 0, 0), mode='circular')
        rx = F.relu(self.xconv(px))
        py = F.pad(obs, (0, 0, 0, self.Y - 1), mode='circular')
        ry = F.relu(self.yconv(py))
        s = F.relu(self.s2(torch.cat([a, rx, ry], dim=1)))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)

    def __init__(self, c, ny, nx):
        super().__init__()
        self.wx = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, nx, nx))
        self.wy = nn.Parameter(torch.empty(c, ny, ny))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wx, -1.0 / math.sqrt(nx), 1.0 / math.sqrt(nx))
        nn.init.uniform_(self.wy, -1.0 / math.sqrt(ny), 1.0 / math.sqrt(ny))

    def forward(self, o):
        xm = torch.einsum('bcyx,cwx->bcyw', o, self.wx)
        ym = torch.einsum('bcyx,cvy->bcvx', o, self.wy)
        xym = torch.einsum('bcyx,cvy->bcvx', xm, self.wy)
        return torch.cat([o, xm, ym, xym], dim=1)


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.amix = AxisMix(spec.in_channels, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.stem = nn.Sequential(
            nn.Conv2d(4 * spec.in_channels, STEM, 1), nn.ReLU(),
            nn.Conv2d(STEM, COL, 1), nn.ReLU())
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        s = self.stem(self.amix(obs))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "n_minibatches": 16}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
AX = 24


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.X = spec.X
        self.Y = spec.Y
        c = spec.in_channels
        self.s1 = nn.Conv2d(c, STEM, 1)
        self.xconv = nn.Conv2d(c, AX, (1, spec.X))
        self.yconv = nn.Conv2d(c, AX, (spec.Y, 1))
        self.s2 = nn.Conv2d(STEM + 2 * AX, COL, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        a = F.relu(self.s1(obs))
        px = F.pad(obs, (0, self.X - 1, 0, 0), mode='circular')
        rx = F.relu(self.xconv(px))
        py = F.pad(obs, (0, 0, 0, self.Y - 1), mode='circular')
        ry = F.relu(self.yconv(py))
        s = F.relu(self.s2(torch.cat([a, rx, ry], dim=1)))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

import torch.nn.functional as F

COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
AX = 24

    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)

        super().__init__()
        self.X = spec.X
        self.Y = spec.Y
        c = spec.in_channels
        self.s1 = nn.Conv2d(c, STEM, 1)
        self.xconv = nn.Conv2d(c, AX, (1, spec.X))
        self.yconv = nn.Conv2d(c, AX, (spec.Y, 1))
        self.s2 = nn.Conv2d(STEM + 2 * AX, COL, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        a = F.relu(self.s1(obs))
        px = F.pad(obs, (0, self.X - 1, 0, 0), mode='circular')
        rx = F.relu(self.xconv(px))
        py = F.pad(obs, (0, 0, 0, self.Y - 1), mode='circular')

import torch
import torch.nn as nn
import torch.nn.functional as F

RECIPE = {"n_envs": 128, "n_minibatches": 16}

STEM = 64
COL = 48
WIDTH = 40
PROJ = 32
HID = 32
AX = 24
AX2 = 20


class PoolHead(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, footprints, proj, hid):
        super().__init__()
        self.fps = [(int(a), int(b)) for a, b in footprints]
        self.proj = nn.Conv2d(c, proj, 1)
        self.mix = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(3 * proj, hid, 1) for _ in self.fps])
        self.outs = nn.ModuleList([nn.Conv2d(hid, 1, 1) for _ in self.fps])

    def forward(self, f):
        p = self.proj(f)
        res = []
        for (dy, dx), mix, out in zip(self.fps, self.mix, self.outs):
            if dy * dx == 1:
                mx, mn, av = p, p, p
            else:
                q = F.pad(p, (0, dx - 1, 0, dy - 1))
                mx = F.max_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                mn = -F.max_pool2d(-q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
                av = F.avg_pool2d(q, (dy, dx), stride=1)
            h = F.relu(mix(torch.cat([mx, mn, av], dim=1)))
            res.append(out(h))
        return torch.cat(res, dim=1).flatten(1)


class RowCol(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, c, ax, ny, nx):
        super().__init__()
        self.X = nx
        self.Y = ny
        self.xc = nn.Conv2d(c, ax, (1, nx))
        self.yc = nn.Conv2d(c, ax, (ny, 1))
        self.mix = nn.Conv2d(2 * ax, c, 1)

    def forward(self, x):
        qx = F.pad(x, (0, self.X - 1, 0, 0), mode='circular')
        qy = F.pad(x, (0, 0, 0, self.Y - 1), mode='circular')
        r = torch.cat([F.relu(self.xc(qx)), F.relu(self.yc(qy))], dim=1)
        return F.relu(x + self.mix(r))


class Net(nn.Module):
    def __init__(self, spec):
        super().__init__()
        self.X = spec.X
        self.Y = spec.Y
        c = spec.in_channels
        self.s1 = nn.Conv2d(c, STEM, 1)
        self.xconv = nn.Conv2d(c, AX, (1, spec.X))
        self.yconv = nn.Conv2d(c, AX, (spec.Y, 1))
        self.s2 = nn.Conv2d(STEM + 2 * AX, COL, 1)
        self.c1 = nn.Conv2d(COL, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.rc1 = RowCol(WIDTH, AX2, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.c2 = nn.Conv2d(WIDTH, WIDTH, 3, padding=1)
        self.rc2 = RowCol(WIDTH, AX2, spec.Y, spec.X)
        self.head = PoolHead(WIDTH, spec.footprints, PROJ, HID)
        self.glob = nn.Sequential(nn.Linear(2 * WIDTH, 64), nn.ReLU())
        self.done_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)
        self.value_head = nn.Linear(64, 1)

    def forward(self, obs, mask):
        a = F.relu(self.s1(obs))
        px = F.pad(obs, (0, self.X - 1, 0, 0), mode='circular')
        rx = F.relu(self.xconv(px))
        py = F.pad(obs, (0, 0, 0, self.Y - 1), mode='circular')
        ry = F.relu(self.yconv(py))
        s = F.relu(self.s2(torch.cat([a, rx, ry], dim=1)))
        x = F.relu(self.c1(s))
        x = self.rc1(x)
        f = F.relu(x + self.c2(x))
        f = self.rc2(f)
        place = self.head(f)
        g = self.glob(torch.cat([f.mean((2, 3)), f.amax((2, 3))], dim=1))
        logits = torch.cat([place, self.done_head(g)], dim=1)
        return logits, self.value_head(g).squeeze(1)


def build_policy(spec):
    return Net(spec)

analyses.1: The starting network scored 0 and learned to choose DONE straight away. The traces suggest why. The target as observed is the true design shifted cyclically along x by 4 columns (X/2). Every row of both diagnostic designs matches this, and rows are not shifted. Actions use the true positions: the untrained agent's first placement was on an observed target cell, yet it got -0.093, which means that cell is outside the true target. The starting network sees only 2–3 cells around each position and uses zero padding, so it cannot connect an action at x to the observation at x+4. With nothing to learn from, every placement looks bad and DONE (reward 0) wins. The main bet is to give the network learned layers that can move information anywhere along each axis or across the grid. These layers must stay general: no hard-coded shift, and any grid size. This round also tests whether more exploration and more samples per unit of compute help keep the agent from settling on DONE.
analyses.2: Both diagnostic traces show that the observed target is the true design shifted cyclically by 4 columns (X/2) in x, with rows unchanged. Networks that only see a local neighbourhood cannot line up the target with the action positions. They find nothing useful to learn and collapse to DONE at step 1: the start, the transformer and r1c3 all did this. r1c1 (AxisMix) learned to undo the shift on seed 0: its greedy placements land at the true design positions, mean IoU is 0.63 and success is 0.6%. Its seed 1 still collapsed, so it escapes collapse only some of the time. It also stops too early. Training is only about 27 updates. Plan: (A) a cheap, general learned full-row and full-column circular convolution front end, so alignment is easy to learn early, before collapse; (B) r1c1 with about twice as many updates for the same samples; (C) A plus B's recipe.
analyses.3: The observed target is shifted cyclically in x by X/2: design column c appears at column c+4 mod 8. To use it, a cell must see its whole row. Circular full-row and full-column convolutions (r2c1, r2c3) solved this at 0.32 and 0.35. Per-channel axis-mix (r1c1, r2c2) scored only 0.00 to 0.04, and attention (r1c2) collapsed to DONE. Running more updates with n_envs 128 helped both front ends, but r2c3's seeds differ a lot (0.62 vs 0.08), so that gain is uncertain. Training success in r2c3 was still rising at the end (0.24, then 0.37, then 0.54), so the run looks budget-limited. The likely next gains are more samples or updates and better global reasoning about build order and when to stop. Each refinement makes one recipe change to r2c3. The new idea adds circular row and column mixing to the deeper features.
analyses.4: The traces show that the target channels are shifted cyclically in x by X/2. Front ends that see a whole row and column through circular convolutions handle this shift on both seeds; per-channel mixing matrices (r1c1, r2c2) and attention (r1c2) handled it poorly or not at all. Adding row/column mixing deeper in the network (r3c3, 0.46) beat the front-end-only version (r2c3, 0.35), and its two seeds were closer together. That gap is still near the noise level. Recipe changes are risky: both 2 PPO epochs and 64 envs made both seeds collapse to DONE first, even with a good network. So the r3c3 recipe stays fixed for the architecture changes. Training success was still rising at the end of r3c3, but the budget trades samples against compute. Since this is the last round, the candidates are: one more global row/column block, wider row/column channels, and one careful change to the discount aimed at the end-of-episode bonus for an exact build.
